questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解：由}L:\left\{\begin{matrix}x=\cos\theta\\y=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta\end{matrix}\right.\theta:0\rightarrow \pi\text{，得}\\&\int_{L}(1+2xy)d x+x^{2}d y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}[1+2\cos\theta(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta)](-\sin\theta)+\cos^{2}\theta\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cos\theta]d\theta\\&=-\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin\theta d\theta-\sqrt{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{2}\theta\cos\theta d\theta+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos^{3}\theta d\theta\\&=\cos\theta\Big|_{0}^{\pi}+\sqrt{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{2}\theta d\sin\theta+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}(1-\sin^{2}\theta)d\sin\theta\\&=-2+\sqrt{2}\frac{\sin^{3}\theta}{3}\Big|_{0}^{\pi}+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\left(\sin\theta-\frac{\sin^{3}\theta}{3}\right)\Big|_{0}^{\pi}\\&=-2-0+0=-2\end{aligned}
